title: Exploring the Underlying Molecular Mechanisms of Chaetomugilin Q in Breast Cancer Using Network Pharmacology, Molecular Docking, and Bioinformatics.
snippet: Chaetomugilin Q has demonstrated anti-tumor effects in preclinical models. However, the potential mechanisms of chaetomugilin Q in treating breast cancer remain unclear. This study used network pharmacology and molecular docking prediction to explore these mechanisms and prioritize candidate targets of chaetomugilin Q in breast cancer. PharmMapper, SuperPre...
